![an image of a minecraft world with strange terrain with text that says, in lowercase, 'surreality'](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/424c4bb4e4f7e1d79203a2b253596b87e8b999eb.png)


A modpack made to replicate the game Lucid Blocks to some extent within Minecraft. It's not overly accurate, but it has at least a lot of the features.




TURN THESE FEATURES ON FOR THE BEST EXPERIENCE:
1. shader on DEFAULT but with Vertex Snapping off
2. resource pack Idyllon
3. render distance less than 8
4. clouds OFF











Credits to all the mods in this that made it feel just right, like the mod 'Sounds So Cold', 'No more perlin noise', and the shader 'Back to Basics'. This wouldnt have been possible without those mods, and all of the other ones that make the pack function.
THIS IS NOT AFFILIATED WITH ERIC ALFARO HIMSELF, THIS IS A FAN PROJECT.
